vc_checking.summary: All 29 cleaned manual obligations are semantically derivable from the current annotation-approved predicates and spatial resources. The simple callable-result VCs follow by unfolding their result predicates and preserving identical spatial frames. CircularAreaRead preparation VCs require descriptor/result bounds, functional uniqueness of CircularAreaDataLengthResult, unsigned normalization, and standard UCharArray/sublist splitting. The two successful return families additionally require list reassembly and modular-index arithmetic. These are proof/helper obligations, not annotation defects.
